People.want: Wants to log into the CCC Agency Portal to issue a policy
People.knowledgeLevel: Can report the exact on-screen message and that the login screen does not appear
People.role: Agency representative from GGG Agency contacting support about a portal login block

People.want: Wants to help the agency regain access to the portal
People.knowledgeLevel: Can verify account status and identify blocks caused by the agency's firewall; cannot bypass local firewalls
People.role: AAA Insurance Support operator who checks accounts and provides network-related guidance

Issue.title: Cannot log into CCC Agency Portal
Issue.description: When attempting to log in to issue a policy, the screen shows 'Access Denied by Corporate Policy' and the login page does not appear

Issue.title: Do not know why access to the portal is blocked
Issue.description: Although the account is active with no restrictions on the insurer's side, the reason for the block is unclear to the agency representative

Solution.title: Contact agency IT to whitelist the portal URL
Solution.description: Ask GGG Agency's IT department to whitelist AAA Insurance's CCC Agency Portal URL in the corporate firewall, as the block is caused by local network security and cannot be bypassed by the insurer

Solution.title: Verify account status and explain the block is caused by the agency's firewall
Solution.description: Check the agency account to confirm it is active with no restrictions and inform the representative that the 'Access Denied by Corporate Policy' message is generated by their office's network security
